name: bind-derived-skips-invalid-names
description: Contract lineage tool names are agent/tool-authored data, not author declarations, so derivation stays inside the same charset envelope a declared `mcpTools` list is validated against by filtering invalid names silently rather than rejecting the manifest. An empty-string `sourceTool`, a charset-invalid `sourceTool` (embedded space), and a charset-invalid stream `source.tool` (embedded slash) MUST all be skipped; only names matching the binding charset survive derivation, in first-appearance order.
